metadata.title: The $d$-invariant of surgeries on $2$-component L-space links
metadata.abstract: Gorsky, B. Liu and Moore provided a formula for the $d$-invariants of integral surgeries on $2$-component $L$-space links with linking number $0$. This paper generalizes these results to the nonzero linking number case. We describe how the $d$-invariant depends on the definiteness of the framing matrix and provide formulae for certain families of positive definite framings, as well as a skein relation for non-algebraically split links.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 研究双分支 L-space links 的整数手术 d-不变量，推广既有 linking number 为零的公式。
techniques: 非代数分裂链环的 skein 关系
analysis.breakthrough: 处理非零 linking number，分析矩阵定性对 d-不变量的影响，并为部分正定 framing 族给出公式。
analysis.limitations: 公式明确针对某些 framing 族，不能读成所有非零 linking number 双分支链环、任意手术系数都有统一显式公式。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: AI 用于笔误校对、LaTeX 和 Figure 3 数值计算的代码，声明排除其他文本和数学内容参与；这是有限用途的正面披露。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.31853v1 · PDF 第 4 页 AI Usage
